description: Contact phone number field containing Singapore-based numbers with inconsistent formatting: international format with '+65' prefix and space (12 characters, 17.9% of values), partial international with '65' prefix and space (11 characters), local 8-digit format without prefix, and one anomalous 7-digit value suggesting possible truncation. Contains 2 NULL values out of 30 records (6.7%). All 28 non-null values are distinct.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Unify phone number formats (~82% of values): convert '65 XXXXXXXX' → '+65 XXXXXXXX' and 'XXXXXXXX' → '+65 XXXXXXXX'.
[CLARIFY] Review the 7-digit value '8964359' which appears truncated compared to the standard 8-digit Singapore phone number format.
[CLARIFY] Confirm whether 2 missing values (6.7%) indicate customers without contact numbers or if data collection is incomplete.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values follow the standard Singapore international format: '+65' followed by exactly 8 digits — e.g., '+65 80734991'.
